information_budget.observation_window: Only calendar months through t-1 enter predictors for month t. This is a retrospectively revised and seasonally adjusted bulk snapshot, not an as-issued forecast archive. Calendar lags do not establish historical release availability; the nominal origin is after prior-month releases. No month-t prices/employment or CPI accounting decomposition enters inputs.
information_budget.calibration_and_history: All regression coefficients, centering/scales and flexible centers fit only preceding development blocks. No held-quarter target fitting.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
scope_ambiguities: Revised vintages; no as-issued economic forecast evaluation.
